source: Shot patterns observed in a reference Bengali course promo (cobalt/lime/daylight palette, talking head + graphics).

recipes.useWhen: The speaker lists 2-4 named things (qualities, tools, outcomes) while staying on camera.
needs: faceBox (eyes.json dominantFaceBox) when the speaker is not centered

params.pills: 2-4 items: { text, tone? } where tone is cobalt | lime | white | red | dark

recipes.timing: Whole entrance reads in <= 34 frames; hold 2.2-4.0 s; pills drift slowly while held.
sound: one soft-pop on the last pill, not one per pill

recipes.useWhen: The script contrasts a common mistake with the better way ('not X, but Y').

params.wrong: 1-4 short labels shown as red cards with an x
params.right: optional 1-4 labels that replace them as lime cards with a check

recipes.timing: Wrong cards land on the spoken mistake; the swap lands on the correction word.
forbidden: red anywhere except the wrong cards and error states

recipes.useWhen: A path or sequence of 2-4 stages (foundation, advanced, professional).
recipes.timing: One step revealed per spoken stage; earlier steps dim to 45%.
sound: soft-pop per step is allowed here because each step is a new idea
forbidden: connector lines or circuit paths between steps

recipes.useWhen: A chapter or section moment: 'module 3', 'top 1% editor'. Gives the eye a rest from busy shots.
forbidden: using it twice in a row

recipes.useWhen: A claim, offer name, or key phrase that deserves the whole screen.

params.accentLine: index of the one line with the accent block

recipes.timing: 1.8-3.2 s; lines reveal through masks 5 frames apart.
forbidden: words that only repeat the voiceover with no added emphasis

recipes.useWhen: The script is about money, apps, or something people do on a phone.
needs: a real or faithfully rebuilt app screen
2-4 floating cards that echo the spoken benefit
recipes.timing: Phone enters with a slow 3D tilt; cards stagger in around it.
sound: soft-pop on the first card only
forbidden: invented bank balances presented as real

recipes.useWhen: Showing a product or workflow as layered app windows.

params.focusOrder: which screen takes focus, in order

recipes.timing: Camera pushes through the stack; one window is sharp at a time.
sound: airy-whoosh per focus change, minimum 1.5 s apart

recipes.useWhen: Revealing the bigger picture: from a detail to the full setup or product.
needs: an outer context image (studio, desk, device)
recipes.timing: Speed-ramp zoom-out over 14-18 frames with velocity blur only at the peak.
sound: airy-whoosh peak on the cut center
forbidden: surrounding chrome visible on the first frame

recipes.useWhen: A key phrase should sit behind the speaker to create depth.
needs: a speaker matte (alpha video or mask) from a segmentation step
recipes.timing: Text slides in behind the speaker; speaker gets a thin white outline.
forbidden: running without a matte (fall back to SPEAKER_ORBIT_PILLS)
